task_title: Route starter + merchant weapons through the equipment system (mainHand/offHand)

plan_review.notes: approved-with-notes; 3 valid concerns addressed: (1) selectFloor1StarterWeapon/applyFloor1LoadoutChoice now check equip result.ok and fall back to setActiveWeapon with a logger.warn on failure, plus module-load validation that every weapon-equipment def references a real WeaponDef; (2) STARTER_WEAPON_ID_TO_ITEM_ID exported from equipmentDefs.ts and consumed by floorScenario.ts (single source of truth, duplicate FLOOR_1_STARTER_WEAPON_TO_SHOP_ITEM_ID deleted); (3) equipPurchasedGear loops all equippable slugs so a purchased hand weapon that cannot equip does not stall the charm; auto-swap-starter deferred as intentional UX (weapons ARE equippable per user spec; slot conflict resolution is a separate follow-up). Concern 4 (getShopkeeperPostQuestStock filters starterChoices not selectedWeaponId) is pre-existing and out of scope.
